newsitem.title: POLAND: Polisa raises motor insurance by 50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Polisa raises motor insurance by 50 pct.

text.p: Polish insurance firm TUR Polisa SA has raised by 50 percent obligatory motor liability premiums as of December 9, because of high damages, the firm's deputy president said on Tuesday.
"According to our analysis there was a need to raise the premiums because of damages in the portfolio," Michal Staniaszek told Reuters.
Polisa has about three perecnt of the car insurance in Poland.
Earlier two largest Polish insurance firms Powszechny Zaklad Ubezpieczen SA (PZU) and Warta raised the obligatory motor liability premiums by an average of 43 and 33 percent respectively.
